strings: r_c0 offers up both good and bad news. The good - m_c's back has healed well and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'ll be able to walk again normally. The bad - it's not perfect, and lingering pain and aches is to be expected.
m_c is happy to be back on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws again, but {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} back still aches quite often. One can hope it'll stop soon.
